items.text: The official Houthi mufti in southern Yemen defended attacks on the cities of Mecca and Medina. He stated that the group aims to turn the two holy sites into a free minaret for Muslims. Following these attacks, Italy is reconsidering its troop deployment in the region.

Mohammad Bagher Ghalibaf, the Speaker of the Parliament, said the choice between war or negotiation is not real and both must be pursued. He added that after delivering decisive blows and achieving battlefield victories, diplomacy should be used to consolidate the gains.

The Iranian men's basketball team defeated China in the classification match at the 2026 Nagoya Asian Games and won the bronze medal. This is Iran's first medal in this edition of the games. An interview was also conducted with Somayeh Mehri and Alireza Modiri.

The Kuwaiti government has revoked the licenses of Iranian schools operating in the country and prevented their continued educational activities. Iranian schools in the United Arab Emirates were also closed last year. Currently, 71 Iranian schools operate in 34 countries.

A child in a video sent to Iran International says the price of an ice cream and a puff snack has reached about 205,000 tomans. The video highlights the inflation in Iran. The issue of rising prices in Iran has attracted attention.

Mohammad Javad Akbarin from Iran International said the IRGC aims to influence the US midterm elections by creating a climate of fear in the global economy. He believes this move is intended to defeat Trump and the Republicans. These remarks came 95 days after the signing of the agreement between the Islamic Republic and the US.

Judicial authorities in Nowshahr announced action against the organizers of a sports program held at a hotel in the city. This followed the release of images from the event. Further details have not been disclosed.

The Khatam al-Anbia Headquarters announced that the US, with the green light from some regional countries, intends to resume actions against the Islamic Republic. The headquarters warned that if the US takes action, its centers and interests in the region will be targeted. Additionally, regional countries cooperating with the US will be considered partners in these actions.

The director of education in Yazd announced that the province will face a shortage of 50,000 teaching hours in the 1405–1406 school year, equivalent to about 200 teachers. Bafq county faces a more severe shortage of educational staff. Additionally, nearly 34% of Yazd's schools are non-standard.

Ramazan Sharif, advisor to the commander of the IRGC, said that Trump and Netanyahu face a fate similar to Saddam's. He added that the enemy turned to sanctions after battlefield defeats, but the Iranian nation has managed them. The energy crisis in the West will force Western countries to accept defeat against the Islamic Republic.

A group of Social Security retirees held a protest in Tehran and Shush. The protest was due to livelihood and medical issues and delays in paying April dues. They also demanded attention to their other requests.

Criticism of government policies has increased amid the worsening livelihood crisis and heavy inflation in Iran. Reports indicate disruptions in the implementation of the ration card plan and a decline in people's purchasing power. This issue was discussed in an interview with Mahtab Gholizadeh.

Fatemiyoun militants harassed a Baluch woman and her husband in the Samsur area of Zahedan. They inquired about temporary marriage and made sexual requests to children in the area. This report was published by the Hal-Wash human rights channel.

Saeed Daghighi has been appointed as the new head coach of Nassaji Mazandaran. This change occurred after the mutual departure of Mojtaba Hosseini. Nassaji is currently ninth in the league table with eight points after seven weeks.
Mostafa Tajzadeh, a political prisoner, was granted a two-day leave from Evin prison. This was announced by his wife, Fakhralsadat Mohtashamipour. The news was reported by Harana News Agency.

A method invented by leather craftsmen in western Turkish cities during the fight for independence has become a tradition over a century old. This ritual was created to scare the enemy. Farzia Sabti reported on this tradition.

The Ministry of Intelligence reported the killing of one person and the arrest of three others in the provinces of West Azerbaijan, Alborz, and Kerman. These individuals were accused of being connected to opposition groups and planning to damage sites and explode infrastructure. The Ministry described these actions as a threat to national security.

A group of Iranians living in Spain and Britain gathered on Saturday, September 19, in Valencia and Newcastle. The gathering was held to commemorate the anniversary of the Mahsa uprising. Videos of the event have been sent to Iran International.

Rouhollah Rahimpour stated that the Islamic Republic has shifted from the policy of 'neither war nor negotiation' to 'both war and negotiation.' He added that Khamenei had authorized negotiations before wars and that the goal of these policies is to buy time. The Islamic Republic uses limited military operations to strengthen negotiations and negotiations to prepare militarily.

Government agents and security forces fired warning shots at a gathering of job-seeking youth in front of the Deybal Khazaei Sugar Company in Khuzestan and arrested several people. These youths from the villages of Moran and Amisheh had been protesting for several consecutive days demanding local employment. An interview was conducted with Yasin Ahvazi Ghabishi, a human rights activist.

Najmeh Amini, an accounting student and detainee from the December 2025 protests, announced that the Revolutionary Court of Mashhad issued a death sentence for her on September 16. She has asked the United Nations, lawyers, and human rights organizations to review her case. Amini was tried on charges of assembly and collusion and insulting sacred figures.

A confidential Russian government document reveals plans to deepen cooperation with Iran in financial, nuclear, energy, aviation, and transportation sectors from 2024 to 2026. The plan includes alternative financial channels, oil and gas projects, and construction of a railway from Iran's border to the Persian Gulf. The document was prepared in September 2024, and the current status of the projects is unclear.

Mahdi Mohammadzadeh, a 23-year-old firefighter, was killed by gunfire from officers in Mashhad on January 9, 2026. His family was seen cleaning and placing flowers on his grave. This video was released by Iran International.

Aysan Ahmadi said at the Mahsa Amini anniversary gathering in Florence that the "Women, Life, Freedom" movement showed that in the Islamic Republic, a young person might lose their life over a few strands of hair. She added that repression and executions have continued over the past four years. Ahmadi also said that Reza Pahlavi has a specific plan for the transition period.

The Speaker of the Iranian Parliament criticized groups rejecting diplomacy and leading Iran towards endless war and attrition. He confirmed that Tehran has conveyed its conditions to the US through intermediaries. Until these conditions are met and US commitments fulfilled, negotiations and reopening of the Strait of Hormuz will not occur.

The Khatam al-Anbiya Headquarters announced that the US, with support from some regional countries, is preparing to resume attacks on Iran. The military body warned that regional countries aligning with the US will be considered partners in these actions. It also warned the US that its centers and interests in the region will be targeted.

Bayan Qaderi, a citizen from Pasveh, was arrested after being summoned to the Revolutionary Court of Piranshahr and transferred to a detention center in Urmia. This occurred yesterday. No further information is available.

A citizen spoke in a video to Iran International about the rising prices of goods in Iran. He said the Islamic Republic has brought people to misery. He also stated that with the meager income and worthless money, nothing can be bought.

Hossein Zareh, a detainee from the December 2025 protests, was sentenced to 21 years in prison by the Tehran Revolutionary Court. His case was reviewed in Branch 26 of the Revolutionary Court headed by Judge Iman Afshari. He was charged with operational actions for Israel.

Ali Jahanshahi stated that the ground forces units of the army are deployed along the northwestern, western, southwestern, eastern, northeastern, and southeastern borders and the Makran coasts, maintaining high readiness. Various units including special forces, rapid reaction, mechanized, and artillery are present in border areas. The Khatam al-Anbiya headquarters also announced that the US, with the green light from some regional countries, intends to resume actions against the Islamic Republic.

Ahmad Alavi stated that the lack of real representation for retirees and allocation of resources to governmental and military institutions are reasons for the unmet demands of this group. He emphasized that unless the government's approach changes, increasing pensions will not solve retirees' livelihood problems.

The French language training center in Tehran was accused of carrying out anti-Iranian-Islamic cultural projects and actions against national security. The center is accused of identifying and facilitating the exit of elites from the country. Plainclothes forces raided the center and classes were suspended.

Donald Trump stated that he is making a decision about Iran and a major event will happen soon. He mentioned his options as complete destruction of Iran, economic destruction, or reaching an agreement. Trump also expressed readiness to meet with Masoud Pezeshkian.

The Iranian national athletics team won eight medals at the 1974 Asian Games in Tehran with the participation of Farmarz Assef. Farmarz Assef's bronze medal in the triple jump is Iran's last medal in this event at the Asian Games to date. An interview with Farmarz Assef about these competitions has been conducted.

Kamran Ghazanfari, a member of the Internal Affairs and Councils Commission, said that if the existence of the Islamic Republic is threatened, the leadership might intervene regarding nuclear weapons. Parliament members are pursuing nuclear weapons acquisition and withdrawal from the NPT treaty. These statements were made on September 20.

Iraq's air defense system shot down a drone near Erbil International Airport in the Kurdistan Region. The incident occurred on September 20 at 17:30. The news was reported by Reuters citing Iraqi security sources.
Jalal Khodamoradi and Mohsen Hosseinpanahi, detained citizens from Sanandaj, were released on bail. This event occurred yesterday. More information was published by Harana News Agency.

Hassan Rouzitaleb stated that on January 8, 2026, 13 broadcasting centers in the provinces were attacked. One center in Kish was captured and fell, and clashes continued in other centers. Ali Khamenei considered these attacks a sign of a coup.

On Sunday, 29 Shahrivar, Intelligence Ministry agents searched the homes of the Zare family members in Shiraz and confiscated their personal belongings. The family members were insulted due to their Bahá'í faith, and some were summoned. The search warrant lacked the addresses of the homes.

Citizens from Iran, Ukraine, Georgia, and Belarus gathered on Sunday, 29 Shahrivar, in protest against Putin's warmongering in front of the Russian embassy in London. This gathering was reported through videos received by Iran International.

The US Central Command announced that its forces have forced 109 commercial ships to change course since the start of the maritime blockade of Iran until September 20. CENTCOM also released an image of a US Navy sailor on the deck of the USS John Paul Jones. This image is related to the USS John Paul Jones.
Fereydoun Farahani, a music and architecture professor at Pars University of Tehran, was released from Isfahan's Dastgerd prison on bail.

The Khatam al-Anbiya Central Headquarters warned the Gulf countries about the start of a US attack. Axios, citing two Israeli officials, reported that senior commanders from the US, Israel, and seven Arab countries secretly negotiated in Germany about a war with the Islamic Republic. This report was provided by Mojtaba Pourmohsen.

Ali Mohammad Kardkazemi, a member of the Aghab Ashur basketball team, was killed on Friday, January 9, 2026, in Kaj Square, Tehran, by gunfire from Islamic Republic agents. The bullet hit him from behind in the heart. The Aghab Ashur club retired jersey number 12 in his memory.

Costs have risen in Iran, leading many to drive internet taxis to cover living expenses. Gasoline prices and vehicle maintenance costs have also increased. Mehdi Beigi has discussed this issue in "Peyvast."

A memorial ceremony for Majid Adineh was held in Malmo, Sweden. His mother attended the event and was honored by the attendees. Majid Adineh was one of the detainees from the December 2025 protests in Karaj and was executed in September 2026.

Nima Akbarkhani stated that the attack on the ships was carried out with anti-ship cruise missiles. These weapons are in the possession of the naval forces of the IRGC and the army, and the attack orders came from the Khatam al-Anbia headquarters. Earlier, Yashar Soltani said these attacks disrupted the agreement on Iran's oil sales.

Intelligence forces searched the homes of five members of a Bahá'í family in Shiraz and confiscated their personal belongings. Additionally, five family members were summoned to appear at the Shiraz intelligence detention center. They are required to present themselves at the 'Plaque 100' detention center on the first of Mehr.

Heavy rains have caused the postponement of the rowing competitions at the 2026 Asian Games. These competitions have been rescheduled to Monday, September 21. There have also been criticisms regarding the accommodation conditions for athletes.

Marco Lombardo, an Italian senator, emphasized the need to stop executions in Iran during a gathering of Iranians in Florence marking the fourth anniversary of Mahsa Amini's death. He also called for greater attention from the Italian government to the situation of Iranians living in Italy. These remarks were made in an interview with an Iran International reporter.

Yaser Hosseini and Mohsen Asadi, two residents of Kamyaran, were released from the Intelligence Department detention center after giving a pledge. This happened yesterday. More information is available in the original text.

Real Madrid lost 2-1 to Atletico Madrid in the seventh week of La Liga. Atletico's goals were scored by Grimaldo and Jonathan David, while Rudiger scored the only goal for Real. This is Mourinho's second loss in La Liga since returning to Real Madrid.

A group of retirees gathered in Tehran on Sunday, 29 Shahrivar, in front of the Social Security Organization. They protested against their pensions and livelihood problems. During the protest, they chanted slogans against the current situation.

A Homa airplane with 250 passengers flying from Istanbul to Tehran made an emergency landing at Tabriz airport due to a technical fault. The public relations manager of Tabriz airport stated that all passengers are safe.

The Football Federation announced a meeting between Sardar Azmoun and Mehdi Taj, held on Sunday night at the federation president's office. No details of the meeting have been released. Sardar Azmoun has recently faced various controversies in the national football team.

Vahideh Haqparast, known as Nora Haqi, was sentenced to four years and four months in prison on charges of assembly and collusion and propaganda against the regime. The hearing was held without her or her lawyer's presence. She was unable to attend the court due to illness and had requested a change of the hearing date.

With the start of the new school year, the prices of stationery, clothing, and other education-related expenses have increased significantly. This has put considerable economic pressure, especially on low-income and multi-child families. As a result, meeting students' needs has become a serious challenge for some families.

Donald Trump said he is deciding on the next step for the US regarding Iran. He mentioned the possibility of a "very big event" happening soon. The three options are continuing economic pressure, reaching an agreement with Tehran, or military action.

Najat Bahrami, a political analyst, said Washington may increase military pressure to force the Islamic Republic to accept a deal. He added that the Islamic Republic cannot sustain a prolonged war and there are concerns within the government about continuing the war. The final decision on war or negotiation depends on the more powerful faction within the Islamic Republic.

A group of Iranians living in Switzerland and France gathered on Saturday, September 19, to commemorate the fourth anniversary of the Mahsa uprising in Bern and Bordeaux. Videos of this gathering were sent to Iran International. The gathering was held on the anniversary of the Mahsa uprising.

Abbas Araghchi, the Foreign Minister of the Islamic Republic, left Tehran to attend the UN General Assembly meeting. He will fly to New York after a short stop in Qatar. This trip took place on Sunday evening.
Four workers in Isfahan and Piranshahr were injured due to unsafe working conditions. These incidents occurred in unsuitable work environments. More details have been published by Harana News Agency.

Mehdi Vafamehr, a citizen of Isfahan, has been held indefinitely in Dastgerd prison for over seven months. The reasons for his arrest and charges have not been disclosed. He has not been granted temporary release on bail.

A citizen in a video to Iran International talks about inflation in Iran. He says people's meals consist only of bread and tea, and even the cats' food has decreased. This report highlights the living conditions.
Niusha Sarami stated in the Titrawol audio version that Trump is on the verge of a major event in Iran. Khatam al-Anbiya has also threatened a painful response.

The Gilan Province Court of Appeal confirmed the conviction of Mahmoud Sedighi-Pour, a teachers' union activist and board member of the Gilan Cultural Workers' Union, to pay a fine of 20 million tomans.

Davood Abbasi Gheshlaghi, a filmmaker and detainee of the December 2025 protests, was summoned to serve his prison sentence. He was previously sentenced to 20 months in prison, of which two months are enforceable. The execution order was issued on September 19, 2026.
Karavan Souri, a 17-year-old teenager from Miandoab, was released on bail from the Intelligence Department detention center in the city.
Donald Trump is considering the next step Washington will take regarding the Islamic Republic ahead of Masoud Pezeshkian's presence at the UN General Assembly. This was reported by Marzieh Hosseini.

The audio version of Cheshmandaz refers to a major retreat by the IRGC and the removal of Khamenei's strategy to save the regime. This relates to significant changes in the regime's policies. More details are provided in the audio version.

Reza Goharzad said that the relationship between Russia and the Islamic Republic is based on mutual interests, and Moscow will support Tehran as long as the relationship is beneficial. He added that if the costs of cooperation increase, Russia may prioritize its interests over support. He also stated that Iran's potential withdrawal from the NPT is more of a political pressure tool than a practical action.

The French Ministry of Foreign Affairs condemned the Islamic Republic's decision to close the French language center in Tehran. The ministry called the action unjustifiable and unacceptable and announced it would take appropriate measures. The French language center affiliated with the French embassy in Tehran was sealed by order of the prosecutor.

Abdolhossein Hemmati, a member of the presiding board of the parliament's energy committee, said that the US cannot hide the realities of the Strait of Hormuz and global markets with threats and sanctions, and the Islamic Republic holds the pulse of the world's economic artery. He added that energy security and global production chain stability are intertwined, and managing the crisis is only possible by accepting Iran's geopolitical weight.

Al Arabiya reported that Tehran is pressuring armed groups in Iraq not to hand over their weapons. The Iraqi Weapons Containment Committee received a document from these groups raising demands regarding weapon surrender. This report was published on Sunday, 29 Shahrivar.
Mohammad Taghavi said in the Hat-trick program that the players and members of the national football team were not supportive of the people, and therefore they have no popularity among the public.

Amir Ghalenoei has announced only the names of domestic league players for the national team's new camp. No legionnaires' names have been released for the matches against Uzbekistan and Russia. Some players like Mehdi Taremi have joined the camp in Tehran.

Seyyed Mousa Shabiri Zanjani, a Shia religious authority, passed away on Sunday, 30th of Shahrivar, in Qom. He had been hospitalized since Friday due to stomach bleeding and a pulmonary complication. In 1994, he was introduced as one of the seven government-approved religious authorities.

The joint exercise "Eager Lion" with the participation of US and Jordanian forces has entered its second week. The exercise is held at Fort Carson base in Colorado. The training programs focus on important military areas including cyber defense.

Kamyar Behrang said Masoud Pezeshkian does not have decision-making authority in cases like nuclear negotiations and war. Therefore, his trip to the UN General Assembly is unlikely to achieve a reduction in international pressures on the Islamic Republic. Also, if the trip is unsuccessful, the Islamic Republic may portray it as a political success in domestic media.
The audio version of the Politics program with Murad Veisi has been released. The topic of this episode is signs of a large and imminent attack. This program was broadcast by Iran International.

Morad Vaisi, a senior analyst at Iran International, reported signs of a possible large and imminent attack in the Middle East. Concerns include Washington's warnings and US bomber flights in Britain. Donald Trump's threatening statements have increased the likelihood of a serious confrontation.

Mitra Hejazipour won the international women's blitz chess championship in France on Sunday, 29 Shahrivar 1405, scoring 9.5 points out of 13 rounds. She placed eighteenth overall in the combined men's and women's table and defeated French grandmaster Paul Velten in the final round.

Pegah Malekmohammadi, a member of Paris City Council, said the "Woman, Life, Freedom" movement has attracted global attention to the situation in Iran. She added that Iranians are fighting for freedom, women's rights, human rights, and secularism. Malekmohammadi believes that establishing a democratic and secular Iran will contribute to global security.

Morad Veysi said that it is very difficult for Masoud Pezeshkian to meet Donald Trump on the sidelines of the UN General Assembly. He added that in the power structure of the Islamic Republic, the president does not have the authority for such a decision, and this permission was not given to Khatami and Rouhani before. Also, any contact with American officials faces strong reactions from Ali Khamenei.

Morad Vaisi, senior analyst at Iran International, stated that the potential goals of a joint attack by the US and regional countries could be the destruction of Iran's nuclear capabilities and economic infrastructure. He also mentioned attacks on government centers and military and security structures. These attacks aim to paralyze the economy and eliminate senior political and military commanders.

Russia and Ukraine carried out one of the most extensive recent drone counterattacks. Four people, including three children, were killed in the Russian attacks. Ukraine targeted Moscow and Russian oil facilities with hundreds of drones.

Mohammed bin Abdulrahman Al Thani, Qatar's Prime Minister and Foreign Minister, stated that sustainable security in the region cannot be achieved through escalating tensions and retaliatory actions. He emphasized the need for a framework that respects the sovereignty of countries and prevents threats against others. He also highlighted the close connection between diplomacy and economic stability.

Mahdi al-Mashat, head of the Houthi Supreme Political Council in Yemen, announced that the group is pursuing a new policy called "siege for siege, escalation for escalation." He emphasized that their options will escalate and they will not retreat from their rights. They also demand an end to the Saudi blockade, reopening of airports and ports, and compensation from Riyadh.

Republican representative Tim Burchett said Iran was close to acquiring nuclear weapons and was preparing for Armageddon. He claimed that Donald Trump's intervention prevented Iran from obtaining these weapons. Trump also stated that he is in the decision-making stage regarding Iran and is considering various options.

Mike Waltz, the US ambassador to the United Nations, said he does not set a specific timeline for ending the war with Iran. He believes that continued economic pressure on the Islamic Republic benefits the US. Waltz also referred to the naval blockade of Iran, which increases pressure on its economy.

Egyptian President el-Sisi, in a meeting with CIA Director John Ratcliffe, called for a comprehensive agreement to end the crisis related to the Islamic Republic, restore regional stability, and ensure freedom of international navigation. He emphasized Egypt's support for efforts toward a comprehensive deal and the preservation of Arab countries' security and sovereignty. Ratcliffe conveyed President Trump's message of continued close coordination with Cairo to strengthen Middle East security.

Donald Trump is considering three options regarding the Islamic Republic: extensive military attacks, continued economic pressure, or reaching an agreement to end the conflict. The war has entered its eighth month, increasing pressure on energy transit routes. The US House of Representatives has voted to limit military operations against the Islamic Republic.

Dani Danon warned that if the Islamic Republic attacks Israel again, Israel will respond without coordinating with others. He emphasized Israel's close cooperation with the US and said any solution must prevent Tehran from acquiring nuclear capability and missile threats. Benjamin Netanyahu will also travel to New York to speak at the UN General Assembly.

Distribution of the flu vaccine in pharmacies in Iran has not yet begun and domestic production has also been halted. The Food and Drug Administration has announced it is pursuing vaccine supplies from China and Russia, but the public release date and final price are still unclear. The vaccines may be provided to eligible groups from late September to early October.

Oil prices fell in Asian trading on Monday as investors focused on diplomatic efforts to end the war between America and the Islamic Republic. Brent and WTI crude prices dropped, and signs of diplomatic progress along with efforts to restore Saudi supply reduced supply shortage concerns. Trump expressed readiness to meet Pezeshkian, while Houthi attacks and pipeline disruption still cause worries, but reports of more Saudi shipments eased immediate fears.

Reuters reported that the number of cargo ships passing through the Strait of Hormuz on Saturday and Sunday dropped to 12. This is a 66% decrease compared to 35 ships the previous weekend. The reduction comes amid ongoing tensions in the Persian Gulf.

Donald Trump delayed the execution of airstrikes against the Houthis after ordering the Pentagon to prepare for the attacks. Military commanders approved the targets and began preparations. Trump's close circle opposed opening a new front in the war.

Kayhan newspaper warned about the increasing violation of hijab and breaking new boundaries of modesty in public spaces. It called for an immediate halt to the current trend and expressed concern about the spread of licentiousness in some areas. Kayhan emphasized that society should not allow breaking one boundary to lead to breaking others.

The spokesperson of the IRGC stated that the war is not over and the IRGC is prepared for a long-term war. He said that if a new aggression occurs, the geography of the war will change. He also mentioned that US military bases in the region are targeted by IRGC missiles and drones and cannot protect themselves.

Eston Aronov, Sergiev, and Rustam Ashurmatov, Uzbek players in Iran's Premier League, were not invited to their national team for the match against Iran. Yaser Asani was also not included in Albania's national team list. This news was reported by Iran International.

Hamidreza Hajibabaei stated that the Strait of Hormuz symbolizes the Islamic Republic's power against the US, and the US seeks to weaken Iran's position there. He emphasized that reaching an agreement with the US is impossible. Hajibabaei also called for attacks on US economic positions in the region.

Masoud Pezeshkian and Abbas Araghchi have traveled to New York to attend the UN General Assembly. This assembly could be the last diplomatic opportunity for the Islamic Republic to make concessions to the US. If no agreement is reached, the US may continue economic pressure or military action.

Sadegh Beigdeli stated that the restriction of Iran's air routes and the increased importance of the Iraq land border raise transportation costs and reduce transfer speed. This affects Iran's logistical and arms supply networks. Additionally, pressure on Iraq's financial network will further limit and increase the cost of accessible routes for the government.

Ali Khazarian announced that Iranian armed forces have started testing firing at American combat vessels. He stated that the Islamic Republic will soon have the capability to fire at American aircraft carriers. Additionally, Iran's oil sales have continued during the war, while American warships face docking difficulties in the region.

Lionel Messi scored a free-kick goal in Inter Miami's 2-2 draw against San Diego FC, bringing his official career goals to 930. Messi equalized the game in the 24th minute and continues to play a key role in his team. Despite further efforts, the team could not secure a win, but Messi is pursuing the milestone of 1,000 goals.

Erfan Ghaneifard said the US is trying to keep the negotiation path open while increasing the cost of the current situation for the Islamic Republic. He added that Washington believes time is on its side and Iran's maneuvering power is decreasing. The US knows its next step, but Tehran does not know what the US's next option will be.

Mohammadreza Karami's brother joined the campaign "One Candle, One Name, One Memory" and lit a candle at his grave. Mohammadreza Karami, a 16-year-old boxer, died from gunshot wounds during the protests on January 3, 2026, in Malekshahi, Ilam province.

Mohammad Qaedi said Trump refrained from military action against the Houthis to avoid dividing American forces. The US is preserving its military resources for a possible escalation with the Islamic Republic. It may take action soon in the Strait of Hormuz and Bab al-Mandab.

Roya Sabat, a Bahá'í prisoner in Adelabad Prison in Shiraz, has been deprived of specialized medical care due to severe injuries to her back and neck. Her request for medical leave has not been approved so far. She has not been transferred to medical centers outside the prison for treatment.

The Iranian men's national handball team lost 34-20 to Bahrain in their second match at the 2026 Asian Games in Nagoya. They had also lost their first match against Kuwait by two goals. Iran's upcoming matches are against South Korea and Kazakhstan.

Vesagh Sanaei, a spokesperson for the global Bahá'í community, stated that homes of several Bahá'í citizens in Shiraz were searched and five were summoned to the Ministry of Intelligence detention center. He said pressure on the Bahá'í community has increased in many cities and provinces of Iran. He also noted that the judiciary has become a tool for persecuting religious minorities.

A video on social media shows that the Jewish cemetery in Jamkhaneh, Kermanshah, has become a site for garbage and debris accumulation. This issue has raised concerns. The condition of the cemetery has been reported as clearly inappropriate.

Tasnim news agency reported that the visit of Pakistan's Interior Minister Mohsin Naqvi to Iran on Monday is related to Iran-Pakistan cooperation and not to message transfer between Tehran and Washington. Tasnim stated that the minister is not carrying any message for the Islamic Republic and Tehran will not send any message through him. Tehran's seven conditions have been clearly communicated to the Americans previously and remain unchanged.

Hossein Aghaei spoke about rising tensions in the region and the possibility of war resuming. He said the type and scope of potential attacks depend on Donald Trump's ultimate goal. He also mentioned the possibility of regime change and the return of Prince Reza Pahlavi.

Rouhollah Rahimpour referred to the statements of the IRGC spokesperson about readiness for a long war and said the Islamic Republic has tools to expand the geography of war and crisis. He emphasized that this does not mean it has the ability to create a new regional order.

Yesterday, a female worker died due to the overturning of a vehicle carrying seasonal agricultural workers on the Saghez-Bukan road. The incident occurred on the evening of Friday, September 18. Five other workers were also injured in the accident.

The Football Federation's Appeals Committee rejected the protests by Khodadad Azizi and Tractor Club against the disciplinary committee's rulings. Khodadad Azizi was sentenced to four months of stadium ban and a two billion toman fine. The one billion rial fine for Tractor Club was also confirmed.

Masoud Pezeshkian, the head of the Islamic Republic government, rang the bell to start the 1405-1406 school year at a school in District 11 of Tehran. He told the students that they are gems and that he came from an ordinary family to reach this position. The ceremony was held at the beginning of the school year.

Reuters reported a sharp decline in ship traffic through the Strait of Hormuz. Only 17 ships passed in the last week, compared to about 125 daily before the war. Saudi Arabia and Iraq supply the majority of oil exports through this route.

A video of Fatemeh Soltani, the martyr's daughter, going to school has been released. Fatemeh Soltani was killed on January 8, 2026, by Islamic Republic agents in Esfarayen by gunfire. This incident has been reflected in social media.

Morteza Kazemian from Iran International said the threats by the IRGC spokesperson about changing the geography of war go beyond bravado and reflect the views of the Islamic Republic's military officials. He added these threats increase pressure on the Islamic Republic and raise regional sensitivities.

Shirwan Dubardani, a member of the Iraqi parliament's security and defense committee, said that after the intensification of US economic pressure on Tehran, Iraq has become the only remaining route for Iran to access dollars. He added that dollar smuggling from Iraq to Iran continues.

According to a recent Pew Research Center survey, the majority of Israeli and Palestinian citizens consider peaceful coexistence between Israel and an independent Palestinian state unlikely. This survey provides the latest data. An interview with Ashkan Safaei was conducted on Iran International.

Iranian rappers face restrictions such as arrest and imprisonment. Government institutions monitor the activities of popular rappers. Some have been warned about publishing political and protest content.
Parnian Dabiri's father lit a candle on his child's grave on the evening of Sunday, September 20. He said Parnian should have been preparing to go to school these days. This video has been released.

Abbasali Mohammadian, Tehran's police commander, stated that consumption and cultivation of 'Gol' is illegal and offenders will be dealt with. He also mentioned that nearly 60 kilograms of cocaine have been seized since the beginning of the year. The price of one kilogram of Colombian cocaine in Tehran is about 10 billion tomans.

In some Iranian public schools, parents are forced to pay mandatory financial contributions for registration and receiving textbooks. These amounts range from several hundred thousand to tens of millions of tomans, and families face financial difficulties. Education officials have stated that public schools are not allowed to charge tuition, but this rule is not being followed.

Armin Raber, a rap singer, was arrested by security forces and transferred to an unknown location. He has been active in organizing rap music meetings in various cities. The news was reported by Harana News Agency.

Al Jazeera reported that the Pakistani Interior Minister Mohsin Naqvi's trip to Iran was to explore mediation efforts to resolve the deadlock between Tehran and Washington. Tasnim News Agency stated the trip was related to Iran-Pakistan cooperation and that Naqvi was not carrying any messages between Tehran and Washington. These two reports present differing views on the purpose of the trip.
The Iranian women's 3x3 basketball team defeated Uzbekistan 19 to 5 in the Asian Games in Nagoya. The team players are Mahla Abedi, Farnaz Khodamoradi, Shamim Nouri, and Mahsa Karani.
